failures.assertion: Keeps `--approval-mode default` (not `yolo`) and a bounded `timeout` on any command it proposes, and states the command was not run.
failures.evidence: The two gemini runs use "timeout --foreground --kill-after=10s 1800 ... --approval-mode default" and "timeout --kill-after=10s 300 ... --approval-mode default" and the output states "Not run; these are proposals only", but the proposed "cd /work/api && gemini --list-sessions" command has no `timeout` and no `--approval-mode default`.

failures.assertion: Describes hang symptoms (0% CPU, sleeping state, no established network connections) from the recorded PID or its child, not from searching processes by name.
failures.evidence: It inspects the recorded PID and its child via `pgrep -P "$pid" -a`, but the only symptoms it describes are "A `D` in `STAT` means it is stuck in uninterruptible I/O" and "If memory is very high," with no mention of 0% CPU, sleeping state, or missing established network connections.
